//go:build integration

package practice

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// TestT12RuntimeFeedback consumes the serialized driver's real PostgreSQL-backed
// Runtime HTTP fixture. It neither supplies a provider nor calls a model.
func TestT12RuntimeFeedback(t *testing.T) {
	required := func(name string) string {
		t.Helper()
		value := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name))
		if value == "" {
			t.Fatalf("%s is required for the opted-in actual Runtime proof", name)
		}
		return value
	}
	// Ordinary integration suites do not opt into this externally serialized proof.
	if os.Getenv("T12_RUNTIME_READY_FILE") == "" {
		t.Skip("T12 actual Runtime proof not selected")
	}
	baseURL := required("T12_RUNTIME_URL")
	token := required("T12_TEACHER_TOKEN")
	readyPath := required("T12_RUNTIME_READY_FILE")
	resultPath := required("T12_TEACHER_RESULT_FILE")
	expected := required("T12_EXPECT_OUTCOME")
	if expected != "FAIL" && expected != "ERROR" && expected != "PASS" {
		t.Fatal("T12_EXPECT_OUTCOME must be FAIL, ERROR, or PASS")
	}
	var ready struct {
		URL                 string  `json:"url"`
		StudentID           string  `json:"student_id"`
		InstanceID          string  `json:"task_instance_id"`
		RevisionID          string  `json:"task_revision_id"`
		ActionID            string  `json:"learning_action_id"`
		SubmissionID        string  `json:"submission_id"`
		WorkspaceDigest     string  `json:"workspace_digest"`
		Outcome             string  `json:"outcome"`
		ErrorClassification *string `json:"error_classification"`
	}
	payload, err := os.ReadFile(readyPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = json.Unmarshal(payload, &ready); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if ready.Outcome != expected || ready.URL != "" && strings.TrimRight(ready.URL, "/") != strings.TrimRight(baseURL, "/") {
		t.Fatal("driver outcome or Runtime URL mismatch")
	}
	for _, value := range []string{ready.StudentID, ready.InstanceID, ready.RevisionID, ready.ActionID, ready.SubmissionID} {
		if _, parseErr := uuid.Parse(value); parseErr != nil {
			t.Fatal("driver identity must be a UUID")
		}
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	client := Client{BaseURL: baseURL, InternalToken: token}
	practice, err := client.GetPracticeTaskContext(ctx, ready.StudentID, ready.InstanceID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("actual Runtime teacher-context: %v", err)
	}
	if practice.TaskRevisionID != ready.RevisionID || practice.LearningActionID != ready.ActionID {
		t.Fatal("actual base context identity differs from persisted fixture")
	}
	validation, err := client.GetPracticeTeacherValidationContext(ctx, practice, ready.ActionID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("actual Runtime validation context: %v", err)
	}
	// This assertion must fail against the original always-unavailable Runtime.
	if !validation.Available || validation.TeacherExplanation == nil || validation.Passed == nil {
		t.Fatal("persisted official feedback must be available from actual Runtime")
	}
	if validation.SubmissionID == nil || *validation.SubmissionID != ready.SubmissionID || validation.WorkspaceDigest == nil || *validation.WorkspaceDigest != ready.WorkspaceDigest {
		t.Fatal("official submission/workspace correlation mismatch")
	}
	if !practice.Validation.Available || practice.Validation.Passed != *validation.Passed {
		t.Fatal("base and explanation persisted outcome mismatch")
	}
	issues := validation.TeacherExplanation.BlockingIssues
	switch expected {
	case "PASS":
		if !*validation.Passed || len(issues) != 0 {
			t.Fatal("PASS must have no blocking issues")
		}
	case "FAIL":
		if *validation.Passed || len(issues) == 0 || ready.ErrorClassification != nil {
			t.Fatal("FAIL requires semantic blocking issues without technical classification")
		}
		for _, issue := range issues {
			if issue.StageID == "" || t12KnownTechnicalCode(issue.Code) {
				t.Fatal("FAIL issue must identify a semantic required stage")
			}
		}
	case "ERROR":
		if *validation.Passed || ready.ErrorClassification == nil || !t12KnownTechnicalCode(*ready.ErrorClassification) || len(issues) != 1 {
			t.Fatal("ERROR requires one known technical classification")
		}
		if issues[0].Code != *ready.ErrorClassification || issues[0].StageID != "" {
			t.Fatal("ERROR must convey technical classification without pretending a semantic stage failure")
		}
	}
	repeated, err := client.GetPracticeTeacherValidationContext(ctx, practice, ready.ActionID)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(validation, repeated) {
		t.Fatal("unchanged durable feedback and source_digest must remain stable across reads")
	}
	foreignStudent := uuid.NewString()
	foreignPractice := practice
	foreignPractice.StudentID = foreignStudent
	if _, err = client.GetPracticeTaskContext(ctx, foreignStudent, ready.InstanceID); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("foreign student base context was accepted")
	}
	if _, err = client.GetPracticeTeacherValidationContext(ctx, foreignPractice, ready.ActionID); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("foreign student explanation was accepted")
	}
	if _, err = client.GetPracticeTeacherValidationContext(ctx, practice, uuid.NewString()); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext) {
		t.Fatal("foreign action explanation must fail closed")
	}
	wrongToken := Client{BaseURL: baseURL, InternalToken: uuid.NewString()}
	if _, err = wrongToken.GetPracticeTeacherValidationContext(ctx, practice, ready.ActionID); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("foreign Teacher credential was accepted")
	}
	// The allowlisted decoded envelope contains no token, workspace files, or raw report.
	proof := struct {
		Schema                 string                                  `json:"schema"`
		Outcome                string                                  `json:"outcome"`
		Context                domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContext `json:"context"`
		RepeatEqual            bool                                    `json:"repeat_equal"`
		ForeignStudentRejected bool                                    `json:"foreign_student_rejected"`
		ForeignActionRejected  bool                                    `json:"foreign_action_rejected"`
		ForeignTokenRejected   bool                                    `json:"foreign_token_rejected"`
	}{"t12-teacher-consumer-proof.v1", expected, validation, true, true, true, true}
	payload, err = json.MarshalIndent(proof, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(resultPath, append(payload, '\n'), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func t12KnownTechnicalCode(value string) bool {
	switch value {
	case "VALIDATOR_TIMEOUT", "VALIDATOR_UNAVAILABLE", "VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL", "STAGE_EXECUTION_ERROR", "SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE", "SNAPSHOT_CORRUPT", "SNAPSHOT_DIGEST_MISMATCH", "UNSUPPORTED_CONFIGURATION", "AUTHORING_DEFECT":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}
